notes: Second isnad («وقال: حدثنا زهير بن معاوية») carries the same saying («و ذكر مثله»), so it is a route; its head is Amr as the speaker, as in worked example 3; «ابن جريج» appears only in this route
The saying's later narrative («فلما رجع إلى منزله ...») is not a link
